Therefore, Paige has 10 songs on her mp3 player.

Your final answer should be a single numerical number, in the form \boxed{answer}, at the end of your response.

Next, we need to determine how many shelves Mike will need. He can fit 9 books on each shelf, and he has 72 books, so he will need 72 / 9 = 8 shelves.

Therefore the answer is 8.

\boxed{8}
